business: SEGMENT: PI car accident intake, Pleasanton (Shotland pilot)
prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t responsibly name one “best” lawyer from online listings alone—reviews and directory rankings don’t establish who will be right for your case. I’d interview **two or three Pleasanton-area injury lawyers** and choose the one who has handled cases like yours, explains the risks plainly, and will be directly involved.

A few local options to include in your calls are **Stephen M. Fuerch**, **Paulo S. Kline Simon**, and **Megan Burns at Mirador Law**. These are starting points, not endorsements; confirm each lawyer’s current license and disciplinary history through the [State Bar of California attorney search](https://apps.calbar.ca.gov/attorney/LicenseeSearch/QuickSearch).

At each consultation, ask:
- Who will personally handle my case, and have you handled similar car-accident injury claims?
- What are the main strengths, uncertainties, and next steps in my case?
- What is the contingency fee, how are case costs handled, and what would I owe if there’s no recovery? Get the terms in writing.
- How often will I receive updates, and who will be my contact?

Don’t feel pressured to sign at the first meeting. Preserve photos, reports, medical records, and insurer communications, and avoid giving a recorded statement to the other driver’s insurer before getting advice. If you tell me what injuries you suffered, whether fault is disputed, and whether you’ve already spoken with an insurer, I can help you narrow down what experience to prioritize.
